summary: Phase 2 backend refactor regression validation. server.py reduced from ~3500 to 126 lines; 18 routers extracted into /app/backend/routes/. Built a new 44-test regression suite touching every router (auth, super_admin, catalogs, clinic_settings, branches, feature_flags, patients, appointments, medical_records, prescriptions, lab_orders, google_calendar, inventory, sales, accounts_receivable, expenses, commissions, reports). Result: 44/44 PASS. Re-ran existing legacy module suites: 158/161 PASS after fix; 1 transient timeout, 3 pre-existing 500-vs-404 normalisation issues from iter 18 (NOT refactor regressions). FOUND ONE REAL REFACTOR REGRESSION and FIXED IT: helper require_clinical_role() lives in routes/medical_records.py but was being CALLED (without import) from routes/prescriptions.py (lines 134, 181) and routes/lab_orders.py (line 110), raising NameError 500 on POST /clinic/prescriptions and POST /clinic/lab-orders. Added missing cross-router import in both files. After fix, all create flows for prescriptions and lab orders work (35/38 module tests pass; remaining 3 are pre-existing 404 issues).

critical_code_review_comments: Refactor REGRESSION: routes/prescriptions.py and routes/lab_orders.py used require_clinical_role(ctx) without importing it. NameError at runtime → 500 on every POST. This is a clear miss when extracting medical_records helpers. Fixed in this iteration via cross-module import; long-term move to core.py.

Cross-router import (routes.prescriptions → routes.medical_records) introduces a structural coupling. Order-of-include in server.py becomes load-order-sensitive. Better: migrate require_clinical_role + CLINICAL_ROLES into core.py, alongside other auth deps.
server.py is now a clean 126 lines, includes all 18 routers, CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router (works for FastAPI but conventionally added before routes). Functionally fine.
core.py centralisation of Supabase clients, Pydantic models, helpers, auth deps is well done — eliminates the previous circular-import problem.
Empty /app/backend/routes/__init__.py is fine; pytest cwd ensures /app/backend is on sys.path.

5 of 18 routers (sales, prescriptions, lab_orders, patients, expenses) have a hidden contract with route ordering: '{id}' catch-alls registered after specific paths. Currently OK but a typo (missing literal route) immediately produces 500 due to UUID parse error in Supabase. Recommend adding pydantic UUID type hints on path params for FastAPI to 422 before db hit.
Test files in /app/backend/tests/ have 4 PytestReturnNotNoneWarning warnings — tests `return` a value instead of `assert`. Cosmetic, not blocking.

rca of the issue: RCA — Missing cross-router helper import. The Phase 2 refactor extracted helper functions defined in /app/backend/server.py into the most semantically-related router (require_clinical_role landed in routes/medical_records.py at line 142). However, prescriptions.py and lab_orders.py still call this helper from inside their endpoint handlers (they share the same medical authorization model). Because Python resolves bare names at call time and the routers are sibling modules with no implicit imports, every write call into prescriptions or lab_orders raised NameError → FastAPI returned 500. REPRODUCTION: POST /api/clinic/prescriptions with valid clinic admin token + valid patient_id → 500 'Internal Server Error', backend log shows 'NameError: name require_clinical_role is not defined'. MITIGATION: Added 'from routes.medical_records import require_clinical_role' to both routers. Verified by re-running test_prescriptions.py and test_lab_orders.py: create flows now succeed (35/38 pass). LONG-TERM: promote helper into core.py to keep routers loosely coupled.
